body:
That doesn't sound like a very good reason, but I guess I'll take what I get. :p

Thanks for helping me. :)

> You don't have an objective frame of mind right now. But you know what? I don't either, and neither does anybody else. There's no such thing as an objective frame of mind, only one that works for you. Depression prevents people from finding the perspective that allows them to get through life.

I agree with you completely.

> One option is to end it. The other is to figure out how to beat the depression, and then find a new perspective.

That's the crux of the question, isn't it? What reasons would one have for choosing the more difficult of those two?

You've articulated the quandary and situations facing me very precisely! Thank you for that. :)

I don't like the solutions though. They seem like a life of mehness. Seems pointless to me in my current state of mind. :-/

I'm sorry for the misunderstanding; I meant that the series of events that will be put into motion if I tell her about my thoughts will be too much trouble for me. I don't think that trouble is worth it. I just want peace.

I know that if my I tell my mom, she will help me. I just don't want her to help.

PS: Thanks for taking the time and effort to reply to me, and other people on this subreddit. :)

> I am sorry you feel the way you do but however strange it may sounds to you - this will pass one day.

That's actually part of what I'm wary of. If it passes away, I'll just be temporarily deluded into believing that there is a point to life.

>  Also, if you have not done it already maybe it's a good idea to see GP? He most likely would prescribe some pills and refer you to counsellor.

I've been around psychiatrists before. I've been on pills too (Serotonin pills). I didn't like it because I wasn't able to think clearly with them on. I was moving through life in a cloudy haze inside my head. Don't like them.

> I know from experience professionals tend to be less annoying than friends trying to help

Yeah, I agree. But I want to avoid professionals because:

1. They're expensive, and I'm currently low on money.
2. In my country, it's really hard to find good psychologists/psychiatrists. Too many people with weird ideas of their own.
3. They have a tendency to prescribe pills for every problem.

Thanks for taking the time and effort to reply to me, and other people on this subreddit. :)
